title: DKIM fail: partial dead-letter move strands .msg in live queue
description: In relay_queue.rs try_deliver_one DKIM failure path (lines 449-464): env_path and msg_path are renamed to dead/ in sequence. If the env_path rename succeeds but the msg_path rename fails (warn logged, execution returns), the .env is in dead/ but the .msg is still in the live queue with no paired .env. On the next drain cycle, drain reads .msg, finds no .env (NotFound case, warn+skip), and the .msg is stranded permanently — never delivered and never moved to dead/. The operator gets only a one-time warn with no follow-up. Fix: rename msg_path first; or roll back env_path on failure; or add a startup orphan-msg scan that also catches .msg files with a paired .env in dead/.
